description: Relays the signed payment (usdSend or sendAsset) to Hyperliquid and applies the plan as soon as Hyperliquid accepts it. dry_run: true runs every check (action, plan and amount, receiver, token, signer, age, balance of the signed source) and answers { dryRun, ok, plan, amount, from, source, wouldRelay } or the error the real call would give, without relaying or applying anything; then send the same action without dry_run within its 10 minutes. Before signing, check typedData (not only action): primaryType HyperliquidTransaction:UsdSend or HyperliquidTransaction:SendAsset, message.destination = receiver and message.amount = your plan's price, both from GET https://waketrades.com/api/v1/subscription; never sign a Withdraw.

dry_run.description: true: run every check and return what the call would do, without saving, sending or relaying anything.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key (1 to 255 printable ASCII characters, for example a UUID): retrying with the same key and arguments within 24 hours returns the first answer and runs nothing again.

signature.description: EIP-712 signature split into r, s, v (v = 27 or 28)

name: submit_payment
title: Pay a plan
